_comment: Maps store names from official locators to one canonical store name. Keys under by_name are compared after shared.store_matching.normalize_name (case, accents and punctuation are ignored). by_id keys are '<source>:<external id>'. A null value drops the store. Names already in STORE_META are matched automatically; list only variants that do not match on their own, or that must stay identical across locators so event keys stay stable. Branches of a chain are separate stores: our 'Jupiter Juegos' scraper covers only Calle de la Cruz 10; 'Genex Comics' (Santa Casilda 3) is not 'Generacion X - Elfo' (Elfo 98, whose Bandai name is 'GenexComics'). StoreResolver also refuses a STORE_META match when postcodes differ.
